marketing_planner_calls: Actual continuous-planner LLM attempts: dated evidence, function output, public rationale, validation status, provider token receipt and estimated cost. Local workers and simulated shoppers are not counted as LLM decisions.
recommendation_models: Fitted local affinity/popularity counts, frozen cutoff, chronological Recall@3 comparison, dataset hash and model artifact. Scores are rankings, not purchase probabilities.
recommendations: One customer/product exposure with its ranked alternatives, model, decision checkpoint, click and optional same-day order. Full-price recommendations cost an assumed 2 cents each. Association is not causal lift.
v_recommendation_journey: Recommendation → simulated click → optional same-day order → modeled transaction → optional native PayPal receipt. Provider and simulated amounts must not be added.
business_goals: Operator objective and simulated budget. Discounts reduce sale proceeds; only outreach is additionally subtracted from contribution.
campaign_assignments: Persistent randomized treatment eligibility versus holdout. Assignment precedes outcomes; non-targeted treatment customers remain in the denominator.
coupons: One-day, single-shopper simulated offers. Ordinary seasons use merchant-funded coupons; Policy Lab explicitly models80% merchant/20% platform funding. No real retailer coupons are issued.
coupon_redemptions: One redemption per coupon, linked to the actual simulated order and discount.
customer_days: Pre-action observed features followed by that day’s offer and purchase outcome. Hidden preferences are excluded.
model_runs: Real CPU training runs, chronological validation, dataset hash, candidate metrics and portable fitted artifacts.
model_scores: Model-versioned purchase probabilities under 0%, 5% and 10% offers. These are our predictions, not Channel3 customer scores.
team_decisions: Recorded decisions with evidence and reasons. Source distinguishes scripted seasons from assistant-in-chat workflow planning; no app-hosted LLM is invoked.
retention_results: Mature 14-day randomized intent-to-treat outcomes among customers active at assignment; includes uncertainty and signed lift.
policy_comparisons: Matched-world comparisons under the same seed, catalog and shocks. Simulation evidence only.
v_coupon_journey: Coupon → customer → merchant → Channel3 product → redemption → order → simulated payment.
v_learning_daily: Observed daily activity and live campaign outcomes, including offer cost and recorded purchase labels.
v_model_history: Model training and promotion history; real local CPU runtimes and validation losses.
v_retention_experiments: Randomized treatment/control retention rates. An estimate of aggregate prevented inactivity, never an individual saved-customer claim.
agent_workflows: Durable campaign missions and workflow state. Planner attribution distinguishes current-chat decisions from scripted demo coordination; tools execute locally.
agent_checkpoints: Idempotent tool requests, planner rationale, evidence references, attempts, status and saved outputs.
campaign_plans: Validated, versioned campaign specifications tied to real locally fitted models and bounded simulation budgets.
campaign_customer_decisions: One recorded decision per shopper and campaign day: observed inputs, model scores, inclusion/exclusion reason, coupon and model lineage.
planner_sessions: App-owned autonomous planner status and immutable per-campaign model-spend allowance. No credentials.
planner_turns: Persisted model inputs, public decisions, validated requests, provider token receipts and execution outcomes. Saved proposals resume without another inference call.
paypal_operations: Checkpointed agent choices and native PayPal API outcomes. Draft invoices and pending subscriptions are not payments. Scenario requests are labeled in evidence_json.
paypal_money_events: Verified native sandbox capture, refund and payout states. Provider timestamps are wall-clock time; these are samples, never additional simulated sales.
v_paypal_agent_actions: Agent rationale and evidence cutoff joined to Channel3 product, shopper, merchant and actual PayPal operation. No secrets or wallet tokens.
policy_lab_runs: Paired economy branches. Same seed, initial state and exogenous draws; settings and assumptions are frozen at creation.
policy_lab_checkpoints: Persisted LLM requests, evidence, decisions, provider usage and execution status. Public rationales, not private chain of thought.
policy_lab_models: Actual locally fitted contextual ridge bandits. Only mature past rewards enter fitting; temporal validation and coefficients are saved.
policy_lab_merchants: Independent numerical merchant policies: own stock and margins determine acceptable discounts. These actors are not LLMs.
policy_lab_actions: One shopper decision per day, including no action; eligible actions and selection propensity, linked order, intervention costs and delayed reward.
policy_lab_daily: Daily simulated commerce and modeled economic outcomes. Whole-market paired comparisons are simulator effects, not real customer ROI.
v_policy_customer_journey: Customer → policy/model → offer → order → simulated transaction/refund → optional PayPal sandbox receipt. Native samples are mirrors, not additional sales.
v_paypal_order_lineage: One row per selected emulator order: Channel3 product IDs, coupon, synthetic merchant/customer, and verified native PayPal sandbox order/capture/fees. Provider timestamps and modeled amounts remain separate. Never add mirrored provider gross to simulated revenue.
simulation_runs: One reproducible simulation and its clock. All dates use Asia/Manila business dates.
merchants: Fictional merchants. All sandbox receipts settle to the one connected test store.
products: Catalog snapshot. Sample or Channel3 provenance, provider ID, observed price and assumed unit cost.
customers: Synthetic shoppers and segments; no personal data.
campaigns: Campaign definitions and planner-authored copy in workflows. Merchant coupons and marketing spend are simulated.
events: Impressions, views, carts, purchases, deliveries and refunds, with event timestamps and foreign keys.
orders: Generated purchase records; currency and all monetary fields reconcile in integer cents.
order_items: Product and quantity lines joined to each order.
transactions: Simulated payment ledger. Never sum these with the mirrored sandbox receipts.
refunds: Simulated buyer returns. These do not issue PayPal refunds.
inventory_movements: Signed stock movements: sale negative, restock positive.
campaign_spend: Simulated ad cost, never charged to an ad platform.
paypal_receipts: Actual sandbox API receipts for a bounded sample of orders. Fictitious funds; actual provider IDs and fees.
v_marketing_transactions: Orders + merchant + customer + campaign + simulated payment/refund + optional native sandbox receipt.
v_daily_merchant_sales: Sales-cohort date totals with ad spend. Refunds are attributed back to the original sale date.
v_campaign_performance: Campaign funnel, retained revenue, spend and ROAS; no causal incrementality claim.
v_inventory: Opening stock + signed movements = on-hand stock.
